notes: Read SKILL.md and references/queues-topics.md, references/error-handling.md in full. TypeScript reference for Azure Service Bus (@azure/service-bus): sending/receiving on queues and topics, sessions, dead-letter handling, scheduling, deferral, receive modes, error codes, lock renewal, graceful shutdown and idempotent processing.

Tells the agent to `npm install @azure/service-bus @azure/identity` (SKILL.md:18, unpinned); sample code authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential to the user's own Service Bus namespace (from SERVICEBUS_NAMESPACE) and sends, receives, completes and dead-letters messages. Medium because of the package install and live-service credential use; acceptable because these are official Microsoft SDK packages and the code targets only the user's own namespace with Entra ID auth.

receiveAndDelete mode and completeMessage permanently remove messages from a real queue; running samples against a production namespace consumes messages. queues-topics.md:52-60 batch-overflow sample discards the new batch (minor bug in sample logic).
